target_moa.text: Calcineurin-inhibitor immunosuppressant; voclosporin inhibits calcineurin in a concentration-dependent manner, blocking lymphocyte activation, with a supportive non-immunologic role in stabilizing podocytes in glomeruli.

citations.quote: LUPKYNIS is a calcineurin-inhibitor immunosuppressant.
Concentration-dependent calcineurin inhibition, measured as the percent of maximum calcineurin inhibition, was observed after oral administration of voclosporin twice daily in healthy volunteers.

Studies in animal models also support a non-immunological role for calcineurin inhibition in kidney function to stabilize actin cytoskeleton and stress fibers in podocytes leading to increased podocyte integrity in glomeruli.
LUPKYNIS (voclosporin) capsules, a calcineurin-inhibitor immunosuppressant, is available for administration as soft gelatin capsules containing 7.9 mg voclosporin per capsule.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥3%) include glomerular filtration rate decreased (26% vs 9% placebo), hypertension (19% vs 9%), diarrhea (19% vs 13%), headache (15% vs 8%), and anemia (12% vs 6%). Serious risks include nephrotoxicity, neurotoxicity (including PRES), and hyperkalemia.
